customer: hey so i just got ur offer on my coupe but i think i still owe more then that on the loan?? can i even sell it to u still. i work nights so id rather sort out how to pay before i come in, can i just put the diff on my credit card
agent: You can still sell us your coupe even if you owe more than our offer, which is called negative equity or being upside down. At the appointment, we'll compare the offer with your payoff letter, and you'll pay the difference then. For that payment we accept a cashier's check, a debit card or a personal check, but we can't accept credit cards. You can find more in our article "If you owe more than our offer."
